source_observations: ObjectID uses bit 63 for RefCounted identity, defines valid as nonzero, and explicitly converts to int64_t. Negative signed values are valid.
HashingContext.update fails on zero bytes. start/finish computes the empty digest without update. Count/stride validation must precede hashing.
MultiMesh::set_mesh assigns the CPU Ref first. GLES3 _multimesh_set_mesh immediately returns for a null RID, leaving a prior stored server RID unchanged.
GLES3 _multimesh_get_mesh only accesses the MultiMesh stored RID, not the referenced Mesh, so CPU/server binding agreement can be checked safely before querying mesh bounds or surface count.

RendererSceneCull::free calls update_dirty_instances before deleting an instance. The MultiMesh dependency update reads the stored mesh RID and calls mesh_get_surface_count when that RID is nonzero. A previously freed Mesh therefore explains the delayed error logged at later node.free.
claim_limit: Pinned source diagnosis plus source-only correction. No new native execution, full-world acceptance, universal renderer-state freeze, or proof of mutation absence between observations.
